# io_trace_snapshot.txt — canonical CRANELISP_IO_TRACE=1 stderr-trace
# event-presence snapshot for the IO trampoline path.
#
# Authored Sprint 66 Phase-5 Stage 1 (/qa, FIXME 0103). Each non-blank,
# non-comment line is a required substring in the captured stderr trace
# when running a representative IO program with `CRANELISP_IO_TRACE=1`.
#
# Why event presence and not line ordering: the FIXME-0103 + D43 Phase-2
# relocation moves the ring-buffer + flush guard from `cranelisp-runtime`
# into `src/io_trace/`. The trace MUST continue to surface the same
# events; their exact line ordering or precise field formatting may shift
# slightly during migration. Event presence is the load-bearing invariant.
#
# Update protocol: when /dev lands FIXME 0103 + 0150 Phase 2 and the
# snapshot intentionally widens, /qa verifies the new shape against the
# facade in `design/arch/facades/intrinsics.md` § "IO observation" and
# this fixture. New tags ADDED here; tags MUST NOT be removed without
# a facade update.

# Trampoline lifecycle (per `design/backend/io-trampoline-trace.md §3`)
TrampolineEnter
TrampolineExit

# Platform-effect dispatch (load + invoke)
PlatformEffect
